# Requirements Lint

Review a requirements document, BRD, FRD, spec or backlog of user stories for the defects reviewers catch in sign-off meetings: ambiguous or subjective wording, untestable statements, undefined terms, missing non-functional requirements, missing edge and error cases, conflicts and duplicates, and statements that bundle several requirements. Runs eleven checks on every statement, opens with a one-paragraph verdict, then a findings table ordered by severity (blocker, major, minor) quoting the original wording, with a proposed rewrite — or a question when the value is unknown — for each defect, plus the non-functional coverage list, glossary gaps and stakeholder questions. The analyst decides what to accept; the document itself is never rewritten unless asked.
